noShortcutsRegisteredForContext: Palibe njira zachidule zolembedwa pa nkhaniyi.
aboutIntro: Njira zachidule za kiyibodi, maphunziro, gulu ndi zina zambiri kuti zikuthandizeni kuphunzira ndi kukulitsa HAX.
haxDescription: HAX ndi dongosolo lolembera lochokera pa intaneti lopangidwira kufalitsa zinthu zopezeka kwa onse, zogawika m'magawo, m'malo ambiri operekera.
joinTheHaxDiscordCommunity: Lowani m'gulu la HAX la Discord
issueQueue: Mzere wa nkhani (mavuto ndi zopempha za zinthu zatsopano)
keyboardShortcutsDescription: Zimalembedwa pamalo amodzi mu HAXcms ndipo zimaonetsedwa molingana ndi nkhani yomwe ikugwira ntchito. Zomangiriza zimagwiritsa ntchito Ctrl+Shift+[Kiyi]; mu mkonzi, kulemba choyambitsa cha markdown kenako mpata kumasintha chipikacho. Lembani {slash} m'chipika cha mawu chopanda kanthu kuti mutsegule Kusaka kwa m'mzere.
searchShortcutBrowserPath: Njira ya msakatuli wa njira zachidule mu kusaka:
tutorialsDescription: Yambani ndi ntchito zotsogoleredwa, kenako pitani ku maphunziro a sitepe ndi sitepe.
customThemeDevelopmentDocs: Zolemba za kupanga mawonekedwe a mwamakonda
apiLinksDescription: HAXcms imatha kufalitsa masamba m'mitundu yosavuta kwa makina kotero zida za LLM zimatha kuwerenga ndi kukonza zomwe zili mkati mwanu popanda kuyeretsa kwambiri.
apiLinksFormats: Onjezani {formats} ku ma URL a masamba kuti mupemphe zotuluka zina za tsamba.
apiLinksLlms: Gwiritsani ntchito {llms} ngati mndandanda wa ma model wa webusayiti iyi, wokhala ndi maulalo a zinthu zofunika zowerengeka ndi makina.
apiLinksPair: Phatikizani {siteJson} (kapangidwe) ndi {searchIndex} (kupeza) kuti mukhale ndi ntchito zamphamvu za AI.
apiLinksOpenapi: Fufuzani pangano la API ya webusayiti pa {openapi}.
